newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at lower levels on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at lower levels on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly lower levels on St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded, the same as Tuesday.

- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, Clinton and South, Load and Release by December 3, $250 per day thereafter, one barge bid at 170 percent of tariff, offered 180 percent, down 15 percentage points.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Illinois River, no bid, offer 160 percent, down five percentage points.
- 10 barges, two each week December, St Louis, Mississippi, bid 100 percent, no offer.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Ohio River, bid 120 percent, offer 135 percent.
